operations.title: Grothendieck reduces Weyl positivity to Pick and Stieltjes source tests
operations.body: Events 1421 and 1423 sharpen the remaining RH/Weyl gate. Ledger 1383: positive theta density automatically passes all one-point imaginary-axis tests, but the first nonautomatic obstruction is the explicit two-height Pick determinant Delta=a1a2/(y1y2)-(a1+a2)^2/(y1+y2)^2; a 60-digit diagnostic grid found no negative sample but is not proof. Ledger 1385: with B(y)=Xi(iy) and R(x)=d/dx log B(sqrt x), RH iff R is Stieltjes. Under RH its measure is sum m_gamma delta_(gamma^2); conversely Stieltjes analyticity forces all poles to the negative squared axis. This identifies the exact positive measure needed for the squared compact-resolvent operator and supplies complete-monotonicity/Hankel-minor falsifiers using theta data only. Remaining task: derive that measure from source structure and lift its signed square root through the paired polarization to a Mellin boundary defect map.
